adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. But `refreshOAuthTokens` is defined as `(refreshFunction, appSlug, userId: number | null)` and, when syncing is enabled, it sends that value as `calcomUserId` in the POST body. Other integrations updated in this diff consistently pass `credential.userId`. Passing a credential record id instead of the user id would cause the sync endpoint to resolve tokens for the wrong/nonexistent user.
